import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from statsmodels.stats.anova import anova_lm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
full = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ ' + ' + '.join(cands) + ' + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
for c in cands:
    red = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ ' + ' + '.join([x for x in cands if x!=c]) + ' + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    ft = full.compare_f_test(red)
    print(f"{c:14s} F={ft[0]:.3f} p={ft[1]:.4g}")
